recovery.reason: User approved fresh corrected preflight and one unchanged pinned installation after prior agent-added guard stopped before execution. Previous installer executions zero.

authorization.scope: One fresh corrected recorded preflight; at most one unchanged pinned installer execution after all required checks pass. No restart, activation, pairing, repeat install or automatic retry.

recovery.ownership: No current child in source worktree; previous stopped-attempt child done/closed. Claim retained. Fresh pane w6R:p6.
recovery.reservations: Inspector reports valid history and unique clean source, start/takeover. No active child/coordinator dispatch identified.

limits: One installer execution; stop on drift, collisions, failure or uncertain operation outcome. No automatic retries, repair, cleanup of unknown partial state or source changes.

corrected_preflight.instruction: Use recorded corrected script, do not recreate or add new guards. Root checked directory/type/owner only, never writability.
